name: Octopus (APAC) Holdings Limited
summary: Octopus (APAC) Holdings Limited is a Singapore-based investment holding company that has transitioned to focus on the import, distribution, brand management, and logistics of premium beverages across the Asia-Pacific region. The company was formerly known as GS Holdings Limited and its business now spans route-to-market, brand stewardship, and brand incubation. Its brand partnerships include Tsingtao and ARVITIS Champagne.
